What the studio does

The work

Custom leads the studio's own description of its work: “custom, traditional, black n grey tattoo work.” Your piece starts with what you bring in.

Traditional work, named in the studio's own description alongside custom and black & grey. The flash book below carries a traditional portrait from the studio's own posts.

Black & grey, in the studio's own words. See the floral portrait forearm piece and the ornamental spine piece in the flash book below.

Piercing is half the shop: the studio is listed as a tattoo and piercing shop, and body piercing is named in its own description.

Walk-ins welcome — appointments welcome too.
